purpose: Repeat P1B after s01 preserved a stale P1A documentation regex and failed to detect the test-owned color markers. Keep the same product/runtime checkpoints while hardening only fixture rendering and color-dominance detection.
requiredClaims: Computer Control display.list observes one stable active online primary display before and after capture
Computer Use acquires the real primary-display frame through the P1A path
a test-owned AppKit fixture renders two noninteractive sRGB markers through explicit opaque content views at independently known primary-display-local logical coordinates
fixture readiness is delayed long enough for compositor stabilization before capture
the PNG is decoded entirely in memory with PNG scanline row zero treated as top capture row
both marker regions are independently located using relative color-channel dominance rather than exact RGB values
the log records only marker-found booleans and never marker coordinates or sampled pixel values
the logical-to-capture projection derived from observed logical and capture dimensions matches both marker rectangles within bounded tolerance
the inverse capture-pixel-to-logical transform maps both observed marker centers back to their independently known logical centers
the transform is derived from observations rather than assuming identity even if both dimensions happen to match
Computer Use product mapping remains UNRESOLVED and interpretation remains NOT_RUN during discovery
no pointer, click, drag, wheel or keyboard action is performed
frame payload is not persisted or logged
test-owned fixture and Computer Control runtime are cleaned up
nonClaims: no OCR or VLM interpretation is validated
no visual target is semantically identified
no public action-coordinate mapping contract is frozen by this discovery alone
no rotated primary display topology is supported by this first discovery
